events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling tree branch
events.description: 1 worker death. Dover, DE. At 2:00 p.m. on November 7, 2024, Employee #1 was cutting a downed tree branch beneath a tree scheduled for removal. A 500-pound branch was cut from a height of approximately 20 feet. The branch fell to the ground, bounced, and then struck the employee, who was working below. The employee sustained fatal internal injuries and head trauma.

events.title: Employee dies from head injuries when crushed by piling equi…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Simon Haus Pile Driving, Llc. Milford, DE. At 3:00 p.m. on August 24, 2024, an employee working as a heavy equipment operator for a construction contractor was checking on the status of a piling machine. The piling equipment engaged while the employee was positioned in the equipment. The employee died from crushing head injuries.

events.title: Employee dies after shot by visitor at residential facility…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dover Operations, Llc. Dover, DE. At 5:30 p.m. on June 4, 2024, an employee working as a painter for an assisted living facility was at home when he received a call from a Coworker #1 (facilitydirector) concerning a disturbance. Coworker #2 (director of maintenance) approached a visitor that he had previously escorted from the premises because of being on a list identified by family members as someone who is unstable. While responding Coworker #1's request, the employee was shot in the head multiple times. The employee died as…

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Let Us Lift It, Inc. Wilmington, DE. At 8:30 a.m. on July 12, 2023, Employee #1 and a coworker were conducting roofing activities in Wilmington, DE. Employee #1 advised the coworker that he had parked his personal vehicle in a one-hour parking zone. Employee #1 told the coworker that he needed to move his truck. The coworker acknowledged he was leaving the area and proceeded up a 28-foot extension ladder. The coworker stated that after some time had passed, he heard a loud crash. The coworker stated that "he immediately came down…

events.title: Employee Dies By Unknown Causes While Working In Grain Tank…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Proximity Malt, Llc. Laurel, DE. At 1:00 a.m. on October 23, 2022, an employee climbed into a barley germination tank at a malt manufacturing facility. The turning auger arm inside of the tank was not working so the employee climbed into the tank using a portable ladder. The employee intended to shovel some wet germinating grain away from the vertical helixes to help troubleshoot why the turning arm was not functioning. A coworker in maintenance witnessed the employee entering the tank. The employee started shoveling grain…

events.title: Employee Is Killed When Ejected From And Crushed By Excavato…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jm Diaz Landscaping, Llc. Lewes, DE. At 11:30 a.m. on September 9, 2022, an employee was operating a mini-Bobcat excavator as a landscaper. When the employee drove over an elevated surface, theexcavator dropped forward and the employee was ejected in front of the vehicle. The employee was killed when his upper body was crushed by the excavator's lift arms.

events.title: Employee Is Killed By Cardiovascular Disease
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jskemp & Brothers, Llc. Dover, DE. At 11:45 p.m. on August 21, 2022, an employee was in his bed at housing as a potato farm worker. The employee was found unresponsive in his bed by Coworker #1 who was his roommate. The employee earlier reported to coworkers that he was not feeling well. Emergency medical services were contacted, and Coworker #2 who was trained in CPR. Coworker #2 conducted CPR until first responders arrived andtook over. The employee was declared dead at the scene. Autopsy results indicated the employee's cause…

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by falling hay bale
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Stinson Mushrooms, Llc. Hockessin, DE. At 9:45 a.m. on August 3, 2022, an employee was standing on the ground facing the first corner stack of four bales of hay along the short end of a multiple row stack of hay bales. The hay bales weighed approximately 1,200 to 1,600 pounds each. The employee was loosening the ropes that were tied to the grommets that were holding the tarp in place. The employee was unclamping the tarp clamps to relieve the rope tension when the top hay bale fell and struck him. The employee died due to blunt…

events.title: Employee dies after being struck by mini excavator
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sunnyfield Contractors, Inc. Dover, DE. At 1:30 p.m. on April 15, 2022, an employee was walking around the mini excavator to retrieve an item from the back of a truck. As the excavator reversed, the employee was struck, knocked to the ground, and driven onto. The excavator ran over the left leg, groin and then stomach. His coworker, the excavator operator, was directed to move the vehicle off the employee and pulledforward. The employee later died due to internal injuries and an infection.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling tree
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Lynn Construction, Llc. Milton, DE. At 1:45 p.m. on December 20, 2021, an employee removed a wedged chainsaw bound in a tree using an excavator. As the employee walked away with the chainsaw, thetree fell and struck the employee from behind. The employee received several bone fractures and contusions that led to death from a heart attack.

events.title: Employee slips and falls in bakery department, later dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Giant Food Llc. Millville, DE. At 04:45 a.m. on August 04, 2021, an employee was walking through the Bakery department. The floor care contractor was stripping flooring near the bakery when the employee walked through the area and slipped and fell. The employee wasinitially hospitalized for a concussion and was later pronounced dead.

events.title: Employee falls from ladder standing on scaffold and is kille…
events.description: 1 worker death. Newark, DE. At 10:00 a.m. on July 26, 2021, an employee stood on a ladder placed on the third level of a scaffold. While working from the ladder, the ladder became unstable and fell off the scaffold. The employee fell approximately thirty feet and was killed by blunt force trauma.

events.title: Employee dies while applying chemicals, attempting to free U…
events.description: 1 worker death. Smyrna, DE. At 6:30 p.m. on July 15, 2021, an employee had been working all day preparing equipment and then travelling to various locations to perform assigned tasks, including applying algaecide treatments to ponds. He arrived at a residential community to treat a pond and was using a UTV to access the pond when the UTV got stuck in the marsh buffer. He went to a hardware store to purchase tools to free the UTV and made multiple attempts using different methods but was unsuccessful. The employee called…

events.title: Employee is killed from gunshot wound
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Cell Talk, Llc. Wilmington, DE. At approximately 5:30 p.m. on May 15, 2021, an employee was managing the store. An armed man came in with a gun and shot and robbed the employee. The employee was killed from a gunshot wound.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bayada Home Health Care, Inc. Wilmington, DE. On January 4, 2021, an employee who had been working in the home of a client died of COVID-19 infection. The employee reported feeling ill after leaving the home, but the date, time and other details leading up to exposure are not indicated in the narrative. The employee may have been exposed to a patient or the patient's family member on January 1, 2021, during her 9:00 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. work shift. According to the Corporate Workers Compensation Manager, the family member was determined to be…

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Seaford, DE. An employee was working in a skilled nursing facility as a secretary to the medical unit where COVID-19 patients were treated when she went on vacation. The employee was hospitalized and subsequently died, due to COVID-19 medical complications, at 7:00 p.m. on November 20, 2020.

events.title: Two employees in lift basket are killed when lift falls over…
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Velex Inc. Bethany Beach, DE. At 11:30 a.m. on November 2, 2020, Employees #1 and #2, employed by a communications installation and repair company, were hanging a 5G antenna on a water tower. They were working from the basket of an aerial lift when the lift fell over, likely due to high winds. The two employees and the lift fell 125 feet, and the lift landed on the employees. Both employees were killed.

events.title: Employee is killed after being pulled into conveyor belt
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Burris Logistics. Harrington, DE. At 8:15 p.m. on September 22, 2020, an employee was attempting to locate boxes of frozen foods that became wedged in a conveyor belt when he became caught in the belt. The employee was killed, most likely from asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Smyrna, DE. An employee was working as a medical professional at a nursing care or skilled nursing facility. He worked with other medical professionals. On May 10, 2020, he died from COVID-19-related issues, believed to be associated with treating patients who tested positive.

events.title: Employee passes out after seizure and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Usda Food Safety And Inspection Service. Selbyville, DE. At 1:30 a.m. on March 19, 2020, an employee was on a work break. The employee went to the restroom, and the employee employee passed out in the restroom from a seizure as attributed to the lack of oxygen. The cause of the seizure is not known and may be possibly attributed to the chemical PPA.

events.title: Employee is run over and killed by loader
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Colonial East, Lp. Rehoboth Beach, DE. At 9:00 a.m. on March 5, 2020, Employee #1, employed by a land development company, was operating a skid steer loader to level the ground in a vacant lot. The machine came alongside a ditch, and the employee was ejected. The loader ran over the employee. Employee #1, who sustained crushing injuries, was killed.

events.title: Employee is crushed and killed by dump truck bed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: The Bros Construction & Landscaping Llc. Millsboro, DE. At 7:45 a.m. on December 5, 2019, an employee was working for a firm that provided landscaping services. A dump truck the firm owned was having problems with its hydraulic system. The employee was servicing the truck and adding fluids. A hydraulic lift failed. The dump body fell down onto the employee. He was crushed and killed.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted when truck comes into contact with…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Nagel Farm Service, Inc. Laurel, DE. At 3:45 p.m. on November 22, 2019, an employee was delivering lime to a farm when the trailer made contact with overhead 7,200 volt powerlines and he was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee collapses while changing out air conditioning unit…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Reybold Group Of Companies, Inc. Bear, DE. At 7:45 p.m. on July 22, 2019, an employee had picked up a replacement air conditioning unit that weighed approximately 50 lbs and delivered it to the worksite. The day was hot and humid. The employee collapsed and died shortly after delivering the unit.

events.title: Employee strikes head against asphalt when knocked down and…
events.description: 1 worker death. Claymont, DE. At 11:45 p.m. on May 27, 2019, an employee was spotting for a forklift driver when the mulch that was piled 8 feet high on a pallet was dislodged and struck the employee on the shoulder. The employee was knocked to the ground and his head on the asphalt, killing him.

events.title: Employee is struck by snapped wire cable and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Atlantic Coast Dismantling, Llc. Wilmington, DE. At 4:15 p.m. on January 11, 2019, an employee was waiting between two excavators to commence demolition. The wire cable used to pull down a column failed (snapped or cut) during the demolition. The employee was struck by the wire cable and sustained a severe laceration to the neck area.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from scaffold during tank cleanin…
events.description: 3 worker deaths. Employer: Industrial Services Group, Inc. Wilmington, DE. At 1:45 p.m. on January 9, 2019, an employee was painting the inside of a large above ground storage tank. The employee fell from mast climbing a scaffold to the bottom of the tank. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the torso, legs, and head, killing him.

events.title: Employee is struck in head by pallet jack battery and is kil…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Allen Harim Foods, Llc. Harbeson, DE. At 8:45 p.m. on October 5, 2018, an employee was looking at an area where the pallet jack battery was stuck. A battery fell of the employee, resulting in blunt force trauma to the head. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by falling tree
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Swartzentruber Sawmill Company. Camden, DE. At 12:45 p.m. on October 2, 2018, an employee was cutting down a large tree and it fell in the wrong direction, crushing the employee's chest and torso. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee hits energized power line with chain saw and is ele…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Asplundh Tree Expert, Llc. Wilmington, DE. At 2:30 p.m. on August 2, 2018, an employee was trimming a tree using a limb puller, gas powered chain saw, and extension tree trimmer. The employee came in to contact with an overhead energized 12kv power line and was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee suffers heart attack, drives track loader off a pie…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Eastern Salt Company, Inc. Claymont, DE. At 12:30 p.m. on February 22, 2018, an employee was operating a track loader at a pier located on the Delaware River. During work, the employee suffered a heartattack, causing him to lose control of the equipment. The track loader fell from the pier and the employee was killed.

events.title: Employee loses balance from roof and is killed in fall
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Delmarva Veteran Builders, Llc. Dover, DE. At 10:00 a.m. on July 31, 2017, an employee was reaching out to take some rafters from a lift prior to installing them. The employee lost his balance or footing and fell approximately 11 feet to the concrete floor and is killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from thirteen story building
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Nrg Energy, Inc. Dagsboro, DE. At approximately 8:00 a.m. on January 31, 2017, an employee was seen walking near the maintenance shop to obtain materials to conduct cleaning on a fly ash silo. He was last seen walking away from the maintenance shop after speaking with an NRG Maintenance Supervisor, to discuss problems with cleaning the fly ash silo. The employee apparently fell from the Boiler Unit Number 4 on the 13 floor, over 100 feet above the ground and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from roof
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Best Quality Construction, Llc. Dover, DE. At approximately 3:45 p.m. on August 27, 2016, Employee #1 was staging shingles on a steep slopped roof. He was wearing a harness but it was not tied off. He slipped and fell approximately 35 feet. Employee #1 received fractures to the base of his skull, ribs and chest and died.

events.title: Employee is killed after inhaling aluminum oxide while treat…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: The Longest Yard Inc. Wilmington, DE. At 8:30 a.m. on December 2, 2015, an employee was placing wood flooring in residential establishments and applying aluminum oxide to treat the flooring. The employee inhaled aluminum oxide, sustained lung damage, and was killed due to asphyxiation.
